chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha', from Ahmad ibn 'A'idh, from 'Umar ibn Hanzalah, who said:
I said to Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام: There may be a heap of food plastered with clay like a rooftop? He said: Pray upon it.

key_terms.السَّطْحِ: a rooftop or flat upper surface
key_terms.الطَّعَامِ: food, here referring to stored grain or produce
key_terms.الْكُدْسُ: a heap or pile, here referring to a heap of food or grain
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: upon it, meaning on that surface

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray on a plastered heap of grain?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) on a heap of grain or food when its surface has been plastered with clay like a roof. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام permits praying on it, indicating the validity of such a surface for prayer in this context.
